title: Latin Tableau Conjecture
statement: A Latin tableau of partition shape λ and partition type μ exists if and only if the chromatic difference sequence of the partition graph of λ dominates μ.

counterexample.description: Partitions λ and μ of the same integer such that the chromatic difference sequence of λ dominates μ, but exhaustive exact search finds no filling of shape λ with color multiplicities μ and no repeated color in any row or column.
